reviewScope: Identity, quoted-security units, reporting currency, economic-model fit, and bounded latest-filing input checks for the sixteen named Guru issuers. This is not a release certificate or a historical-node audit.
activationPolicy: Only companies with reviewStatus=reviewed may be merged into the active Guru universe. Identity/profile approval alone does not approve staged inputs. Unreviewed rows remain fail-closed, even when a proposed model is identified. No price or expected return is an input to this review.

sharedChecks.source: Read-only candidate-identities.json, candidate-source.sqlite raw records and dated SEC filings
sharedChecks.sourceShareFactors: All sixteen local raw histories have provider sharefactor=1. This observation is not a substitute for the official security-unit evidence below.
sharedChecks.rawCurrencyLimitation: Raw staged records do not independently carry historical statement currency. The current issuer currency review cannot be described as validation of every historical node.
sharedChecks.shareCountLimitation: Provider sharesbas sometimes uses the filing-cover observation rather than fiscal-period-end shares. Validate and preserve the actual observation date; never relabel a later cover count as period-end.
sharedChecks.standardModelLimitations: Normalized earnings and FCFE estimates are analyst models, not issuer guidance. Debt/cash, SBC dilution and working-capital assumptions still require the normal strict source/model release checks; approved profile selection does not waive them.
